'''Innloine Damodred''' is the daughter of [[Dalresin Damodred]], the sister of [[Anvaere Damodred|Anvaere]] and [[Moiraine Damodred]], and the half-sister of [[Taringail Damodred]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Innloine Damodred}} She is a warm and loving mother but is not terribly bright. she is, however, rather stubborn.{{ref/book|0|6}}

== History ==
After the death of King [[Laman Damodred]] in the [[Aiel War]], Moiraine discounted Innloine as a potential successor to the [[Sun Throne]], for if she were to become queen, affairs of state would come a poor second to playing with her children, in Moiraine's opinion.{{ref/book|0|6}}
